accessibility_findings.luxecard: Follows Material Design accessibility standards (touch targets ≥48px via padding, respects text scaling)
accessibility_findings.luxebutton: Inherits Material Design focus indicators, minimum 48px touch target via padding
accessibility_findings.s4textfield: Uses Token-based colors for contrast, respects text scaling via TextStyle, helper/error text support
accessibility_findings.migration_impact: Maintains or improves accessibility via token-based colors and spacing; no regressions expected

audience_assessment.general: All candidates are audience-agnostic or receive differentiation via S1 Color, S2 Typography, AudienceService
audience_assessment.women: No audience-specific variants required; differentiation handled by tokens and AudienceService
audience_assessment.men: Same as women; MensTheme and isMen flags in tokens provide differentiation
audience_assessment.aura: No aura-specific logic in candidates; AURA logic remains in Token/S1/S2 layers

technical_debt_discovered: Duplicate input implementations across auth, profile, ideas screens
Duplicate button implementations across screens (ElevatedButton, TextButton, OutlineButton)
Missing canonical error and empty state components
Inconsistent use of Shimmer vs S4SkeletonLoader for loading placeholders
Use of raw CircularProgressIndicator and ad-hoc Container for error/empty states
recommended_migration_order: Buttons (quick view, chat, reserve) - straightforward UI actions
AI search bar - reusable widget; update in one place
State loading (replace CircularProgressIndicator with S4SkeletonLoader) - low risk
Error/Empty states - defer until canonical S4Error/S4Empty are defined (out of Expansion 02 scope)

quality_assessment.evidence_based: All findings derived from direct file inspection and repository search
quality_assessment.no_assumptions: Only reported what was observed in the codebase
quality_assessment.controlled_scope: Limited to CARD, BUTTON, INPUT, STATE domains; excluded navigation, AppBar, BottomNavigation, photography, token architecture, backend, etc.
quality_assessment.alignment_with_s4i_principles: Follows EXISTING CODE FIRST, reuse canonical where possible, avoid redesign
